rows.hypothesis: Semiconductor yield detractor screening: which of 590 inline sensors in UCI SECOM are associated with lot failure
rows.verdict_detail: 2 of 32 shortlisted sensors replicate on the holdout (post-hoc); the predictive baseline is at no skill
rows.mechanism: The failure rate drifts across the collection window and 16 of the 32 train-screen survivors trend with time, and the associations mostly fail to transfer: 15 of 32 keep their sign on the holdout and only sensor_103 and sensor_510 replicate under BH.

stats.label: screen p, time order preserving null
stats.locator: permutation_time_order.permutation_p_value (32 of 424 at BH q = 0.10; 34 of 1095 circular shifts reach 32)

caveats: The declared iid permutation null gives p = 0.0005, its floor at 2000 permutations; the time order preserving null is a post-hoc sensitivity.
The replication analysis is post-hoc and rests on 26 holdout failures; a designed experiment on the two sensors is specified (1346 lots) but not run.
Holdout PR-AUC 0.062 (95 percent interval 0.050 to 0.098) against a no-skill floor of 0.055.
